snippet.title: Cascadou Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the exploding solitaire roguelike now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842900/Cascadou/

Cascadou is a delightful chain‑reaction deck builder where poker hands topple into each other like dominoes. Each round raises the target score, so plan your sequence, trigger explosive cascades, and use smart upgrades to keep the run alive.

Join the discord:
https://discord.gg/pk8qcmBtmF

Website:
www.machineboy.com
